# The Green Will Conservancy

> A Hawaii-based organization providing EMDR therapy, professional training, and community wellness programs for trauma treatment and mental health services.

The Green Will Conservancy operates as both a clinical practice and training institute, offering EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) therapy to individuals and families while providing continuing education and professional development for mental health practitioners. The organization integrates trauma-informed care with community programs, youth services, and spiritual retreats rooted in Hawaiian culture.

## Key Topics

- EMDR therapy
- Trauma-informed care
- Professional training
- Mental health services
- Hawaii-based programs
- Continuing education
- Clinical supervision
- Community wellness
- Transpersonal therapy
- Nervous system regulation
- Youth programs
- Foster care resources
- Attachment theory
- EMDRIA certification
- Organizational development

## Core Services & Programs

- [The Green Will Conservancy](https://thegreenwill.org): Homepage for Green Will Conservancy offering EMDR therapy, youth programs, and mental health services in Hawaii.
- [Who we are and how to reach our services](https://thegreenwill.org/who-we-are): About page describing Green Will Conservancy's mission, contact information, and service overview.
- [Hawaii Community Program](https://thegreenwill.org/hawaii-community-program): Overview of Green Will Conservancy's Hawaii community programs including EMDR, social club, and wellness services.
- [Mind Body Health](https://thegreenwill.org/mind-body-health): Mental health and physical fitness programs including EMDR therapy and Hatha Yoga instruction.
- [EMDR Treatment, Consultation and Organizational Development](https://thegreenwill.org/http-thegreenwill-org-consultation-organizational-development): EMDR psychotherapy services, consultation, and organizational development for trauma-capable care.

## Professional Training & Education

- [On-going Professional Training Available](https://thegreenwill.org/going-professional-training-available): EMDR training and continuing education for mental health professionals at Green Will Conservancy Training Institute.
- [Professional Learning Community](https://thegreenwill.org/professional-learning-community): Professional learning community offering trauma-informed care training and EMDR consultation for healthcare providers.
- [Trauma Capable Care Conference](https://thegreenwill.org/trauma-capable-care-conference): Professional conference on trauma-capable care for practitioners with EMDR and clinical training.
- [Participate in Professional Learning](https://thegreenwill.org/professional-learning-community/join-quest): Registration page for peer review consultation group, research opportunities, internships, and volunteer programs.

## Group Programs & Community Wellness

- [Friendship House, On-line and onsite Social Club Activities](https://thegreenwill.org/onsite-social-club-activities): Friendship House social club and sustainable garden program for youth, families, and elder mentors in Hawaii.
- [Resourceful Connections: Adult EMDR Group Program](https://thegreenwill.org/resourceful-connections-adult-emdr-group-program): Weekly Zoom-based adult EMDR group program for trauma processing and resource building.

## Specialized Retreats & Advanced Training

- [EMDR as a Transpersonal Therapy: A Cross Cultural Perspective Where East Meets West Hawaiian Retreat](https://thegreenwill.org/emdr-as-a-transpersonal-therapy-a-cross-cultural-perspective-where-east-meets-west-hawaiian-retreat-2): EMDR transpersonal therapy retreat in Hawaii with cross-cultural perspective presented by Irene Siegel, Ph.D.
- [Awakening Ancestral Memory](https://thegreenwill.org/awakening-ancestral-memory-2): Hawaiian retreat program on ancestral memory and spiritual awakening led by Irene Siegel, Ph.D.
- [Attachment, Love, and Trauma: David Kazmierczak on Integrating EMDR With Relational Models](https://thegreenwill.org/attachment-love-and-trauma-david-kazmierczak-on-integrating-emdr-with-relational-models): Video article by David Kazmierczak on integrating EMDR with relational models and attachment theory.

## Resources & Support

- [Professional Academic Library](https://thegreenwill.org/library): Academic library with research papers on EMDR, trauma treatment, and mental health topics.
- [Hawaiian Foster Care Resource Hub](https://thegreenwill.org/fostercare): Resource hub with FAQs and information for foster parents and youth in Hawaii.
